decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing profile shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of the position of the CCTV cameras, camera system to be used and public help points have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and then installed as approved
Condition : 6 - The windows within the north facing elevation of the lift lobby shall be obscure glazed and fixed shut.

Condition : 7 - Before construction commences, detailed drawings showing 1:20 sections through the existing and proposed, to ensure alignments of new / existing structural and cladding elements are appropriate, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before they are installed, details of the sections of all new windows, alterations of existing windows and the way they are to be joined, at 1:10 scale, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA and the details so approved shall be implemented.

Condition : 9 - Before they are installed, details of the new roof, flashings and copings and also their relationship with the existing building at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA and the details so approved shall be implemented.

Condition : 10 - During the works a full record shall be made (and annotated, including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a log book and a copy of which shall be lodged with the local planning authority within one month after the works hereby approved are completed.
description: The installation of two new lifts, one to each platform and associated lift lobbies connecting to the existing track over bridge including cctv, public address and public help points
